notes.title: A Painter's Tale: Curon, 1950
notes.content:
[h1]A Painter's Tale: Curon, 1950 is out now![/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25080113/714a006e433632a1b8f20fb01d6d27d9762fc224.png[/img]

A Painter’s Tale: Curon, 1950 is a story about love and resistance, an adventure game about historical memory. The bell tower that comes out of the lake is the last memento of the old village of Curon, flooded by the waters of Lake Reschen in 1950 due to the construction of a dam, despite the protest of the citizens. The plans for the dam started during the Fascist era, opposing the interests of a big industrial group to the wellbeing of the villagers, who were forced to leave their homes and pastures.

[b]What lies beneath the bell tower still emerging from the lake?[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1283370/A_Painters_Tale_Curon_1950

notes.title: Screenshoot Competition
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/471741ed4f003b0fde4fc62d6a1ed183c430a258.jpg[/img]

Start officially today our first photo contest "The NADI Project - Screenshoot Competition"!

[h1]How to participate? It's easy![/h1]
[olist]
    [*]Download the last version of "The NADI Project" from Steam
    [*]Make the Best Screen of the Century (F12)
    [*]Upload the image to Steam with the #thenadiproject tag
[/olist]
Alternatively, you can also edit the image with an external editor (Photoshop, etc.) and load it in the IMAGE section of Steam, ever with the tag #thenadiproject.

[h1]What do you win?[/h1]
Best picture will be selected by the Monkeys Tales Team and published on all our social network with the mention of the author.

[b] Images can be uploaded until October 9th, 2017 [/b]

Are you ready ?? We look forward to seeing your stunning works!
Ready...GO !!!

notes.title: THE NADI PROJECT UPDATE 1.5 OUT NOW !!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/66ff661c0a2c43e97c64864aea3cc99f6b047a81.png[/img]

We're proud to announce the very first huge update to version 1.5 after two years from the launch of the game !!!
We worked hard to increase user experience and add little more features in gameplay. We hope you can enjoy our work and play again with our new shining title !

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/6cc4beda29b918f125804d241622a694ab8c385d.jpg[/img]

Here the complete changelog:
[list]
    [*]Improved graphics and lights
    [*]A stunning fresh new english translation !
    [*]Global performance optimization
    [*]FIX collision system
    [*]FIX save system
    [*]FIX UI system
    [*]Fixed some dialogues
    [*]ADD options menu
    [*]ADD mouse sensibility controls
    [*]ADD Win64 build
    [*]ADD OSX build
    [*]Engine updates
    [*]Other minor bugs corrected
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/93e02162770c4f1128fea61869b4d90fb30bf78f.jpg[/img]

We've had an overwhelming response from the community, offering gameplay ideas, informative reviews and so much more so we'd like to take the opportunity to thank those who have chipped in! 

We hope you enjoy the game and please do let us know your thoughts in the comments section! Thank you all for reading. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25080113/b18b847a93d4d9f97bdc9dfaff66a4b8fe3cf171.jpg[/img]

Don’t forget you can follow Monkeys Tales Studio on our [url=https://twitter.com/monkeys_tales] Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/monkeystales] Facebook[/url] page. 


See you soon !
Monkeys Tales Studio
